question: Should this mutating Claws apply slice proceed now with canonical shared-state schema integration, or wait until the Claws/RFC stack is accepted?
rationale: The PR adds new CLI mutation and persistent shared-state data for an unreleased feature; automation can point at the schema defect, but maintainers need to confirm the Claws state model and landing order.

options.title: Require State-Schema Integration
options.body: Keep the PR open but require the Claw provenance tables and queries to move through the canonical state schema/generated-type path before merge.

options.title: Pause Until Base Stack Lands
options.body: Leave this draft parked behind the non-mutating Claws validation PR and revisit mutation after the RFC/base surface is accepted.

options.title: Accept Draft Risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the current runtime-created table shape as a temporary draft-only slice, but that should be explicit before merge.

recommendation.title: Require State-Schema Integration
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require the Claw provenance tables and queries to move through the canonical state schema/generated-type path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared-state work and PR timeline mentions make this the best available owner for the storage/product landing decision.
